attributes.name: Silas Vekker
attributes.powers:
Silas is immune to the Mental and Poison traits.

Each character at this location encounters Silas Vekker. If any character does not defeat Silas, Silas deals 1d4-1 Poison damage to that character, and is undefeated.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close this location.
